facts.fact: NIRA says it launched the HUBIYE Verifier Platform, which enables real-time verification of national ID credentials by public and private institutions.
NIRA says it launched the e-Aqoonsi Digital ID App, which gives citizens a digital ID on their mobile devices for accessing online and offline services.

SOM.note: Nothing on a link between civil register and ID system.
No count or share of people enrolled is given.
Nothing on a number at birth.

facts.fact: NIRA's Director General says the three launched systems (HUBIYE, e-Aqoonsi, CDS) were entirely developed by Somali engineers at NIRA, reflecting national ownership.

SOM.note: No public register is said to be keyed on the ID number.
The document does not say the ID system issues unique numbers, checks biometrics or is certified.

facts.fact: NIRA says a Prime Ministerial Directive of 21 April 2025 mandates integration of all public-facing services with the HUBIYE platform for identity verification; no service is said to be verifying yet.
NIRA says it launched three systems (HUBIYE, e-Aqoonsi, CDS) entirely developed by Somali engineers at NIRA, with World Bank Scaled-UP Project support.
